threshold_note: T_roll_p50 threshold; threshold_value is latest if rolling
strategy_description: Hold SPY when the lagged cement-shipment-growth signal is favorable (firm); otherwise hold cash.
lead_description: Signal is lagged 8 month(s) before allocation.
notes: Portland Cement Shipments is a construction-activity indicator; the nominal-dollar level is non-stationary so all signals are growth transforms. Winner (chg_6m) is selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window (2011-01-31 to 2016-12-31) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window (from 2017-01); still a search-selected rule — read as found-in-search.

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start 2017-01)) monthly mean/std*sqrt(12); winner evaluated on OOS window

is_window.rule: eligibility before alignment: a candidate is IS-eligible only if its own first-valid-return date leaves >= MIN_IS_N=60 IS obs before oos_start; common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date among ELIGIBLE candidates; IS metrics computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the published grid; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: Pre-GH#251 OOS-argmax selection, comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only
